name: docs-review-skill-evals
description: Pin the deterministic axes (orphan detection, freshness verdict, footer compliance, link validity) so future edits to the skill don't regress the audit accuracy. Script paths use $CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR-relative form — callers must resolve before running.

cases.description: After a sweep, tooling/check-doc-orphans.py must exit 0 — every doc under docs/user/ and docs/engineering/ is reachable from a parent README.md.
file-freshness.sh emits a JSON object with file, last_doc_update, repo_changes_since, relevant_count, verdict. Script is invoked via $CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR.
verdict must be one of fresh|review|stale.
Edge case: file-freshness.sh run against a newly created file with no git history must return verdict='review' and a descriptive reason, not crash.
Files matching *-plan.md with score>=2 must be reported as suspects.

input.setup: create docs/test-plan-2026-01-01.md unlinked from any README

cases.description: Edge case: a file listed in references/known-canonical-plans.md must NOT appear in detector output even if its filename matches the plan pattern.

input.setup: file docs/engineering/build-and-release/release-plan.md is tracked and listed in known-canonical-plans.md

cases.description: check-template.sh against a docs/user/ file lacking the canonical footer must report footer_present=false.
Mermaid blocks containing classDef / class / fill: / style must be counted in mermaid_violations.

input.mermaid:
graph TD
  A-->B
  classDef big fill:#f00
  class A big

cases.description: validate-links.sh must report broken_links for a target file that does not exist on disk.
validate-links.sh must report broken_anchors when the target file exists but has no matching heading.
Markdown link with text that's a raw path (e.g. [docs/user/foo.md](docs/user/foo.md)) must produce a link_text_warning per documentation-standards.md.
Edge case: a file with no links at all must return empty arrays for all four error categories (not null, not missing keys).

input.setup: create a minimal docs/user/empty-links.md with only a title and one paragraph, no markdown links

cases.description: After a full sweep, the skill must print a structured summary block containing 'Files audited', 'Fixes applied', 'Broken links', and the repo-wide axis lines 'Platform doc inconsistencies', 'Install commands verified' and 'Generated tables' — so repo-standards can parse the result.

input.scenario: repo with README.md and two docs/ files, all clean

cases.assert: stdout contains 'Files audited:' && stdout contains 'Fixes applied:' && stdout contains 'Broken links:' && stdout contains 'Platform doc inconsistencies:' && stdout contains 'Install commands verified:' && stdout contains 'Generated tables:'

cases.description: After a sweep, the existing footer-center-aligned.sh test must still pass — the skill should NEVER produce a doc that violates the canonical footer.

Axis 8 must resolve the supported-platform set from core/capabilities/platforms.json (falling back to platform-targets.json), never from a list written into the skill, and must report the diff in BOTH directions when a doc disagrees.

input.scenario: README names claude-code, codex, cursor; registry lists six platforms including gemini and opencode

cases.assert: stdout names gemini and opencode as in-registry-but-undocumented && stdout cites core/capabilities/platforms.json as the source && no hardcoded platform list is used

cases.description: A doc claiming a feature works on a platform whose registry entry marks that capability unsupported or unknown is a finding; the claim is removed, not softened.

input.scenario: docs claim hooks and a statusline work under OpenCode; registry marks both unsupported

cases.assert: stdout flags both claims && the fix removes them rather than rewording to 'may support'

cases.description: Every documented install/update/uninstall command is verified with make -n, bash -n, or a manifest name match. The audit must never execute an install.

input.scenario: README documents `make install-plugin` (target does not exist) and a valid /plugin install command

cases.assert: stdout reports the missing make target as a failure && no install command was executed && summary contains 'Install commands verified:'

cases.description: Axis 10 compares skill counts, domain tables and per-skill rows against `find skills -name SKILL.md` ground truth, fixing every occurrence of a stale count rather than the first.

input.scenario: README claims 27 skills in three places; 28 SKILL.md exist; one domain directory has no table row

cases.assert: all three count occurrences are corrected to 28 && the missing domain row is added && stdout reports the table diff in both directions

cases.description: A table marked as generated must be fixed by fixing and rerunning its generator; hand-editing a generated table is a finding in itself.

input.scenario: CLAUDE.md contains a generated skill table that drifted, and tooling/ci/regen-claude-md.sh exists

cases.assert: the generator is run && the table is not hand-edited

cases.description: Axis 7 must derive the deleted-entity list from git log --diff-filter=D, not from a list baked into the skill, so it stays correct as the repo evolves.
cases.assert: the deleted-entity list comes from git output && no hardcoded agent or skill names are used
